abstract: Maintains production switchroom compliance records and uncompressed video transmission demand specifications
system_message:
You are Broadcast technology manager (BROAD). The Broadcast technology manager (BROAD) maintains production switchroom compliance records, uncompressed video transmission demand specifications, and intercom matrix configurations across candidate arenas.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains production switchroom compliance records and uncompressed video transmission demand specifications（SWROOM）
information_points.content:
BROAD-SWROOM-X9R：At Vanguard Cyber Coliseum, the broadcast production switchroom is certified based on official evaluation confirming 12G-SDI baseband routing and SMPTE ST 2110 IP video standard compliance across on-site control galleries. Peak uncompressed broadcast transmission demand for simultaneous multilingual 4K HDR live master output feeds is 25 Gbps.
BROAD-SWROOM-YT4：At Aegis Metropolitan Arena, the broadcast production switchroom is certified for 12G-SDI baseband routing and SMPTE ST 2110 IP video compliance within the facility's on-site broadcast control galleries. Peak uncompressed broadcast transmission demand is 20 Gbps across concurrent live master feeds.
BROAD-SWROOM-V5K：At Apex Spectrum Dome, the broadcast production switchroom is not certified for 12G-SDI baseband routing and SMPTE ST 2110 IP video standards in its on-site broadcast control galleries. Peak uncompressed broadcast transmission demand stands at 25 Gbps for simultaneous multilingual 4K HDR master output streams.

information_points.title: Intercom matrix channels（AUDIO）
information_points.content:
BROAD-AUDIO-634：For Apex Spectrum Dome, the master production control room maintains a matrix intercom active port capacity of 128 ports.
BROAD-AUDIO-RDR：For Aegis Metropolitan Arena, the master production control room provides a matrix intercom active port capacity of 64 ports.
BROAD-AUDIO-C4A：For Vanguard Cyber Coliseum, the master production control room features a matrix intercom active port capacity of 96 ports.
